description: Na₃MgBiO₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic Pm space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.77 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (2.22 Å) and two longer (2.39 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.50 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing MgO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.04 Å. Bi is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.29 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two Na and two equivalent Bi atoms to form ONa₂Bi₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent ONa₃MgBi trigonal bipyramids and corners with two equivalent ONa₂Bi₂ trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Bi atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two equivalent Mg atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one Bi atom to form ONa₃MgBi trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃MgBi trigonal bipyramids and corners with four equivalent ONa₂Bi₂ trigonal pyramids.
